Name: More Mushrooms
Author: jayjaydub
Description:
Are those pesky mushroom boxes just not giving you what you need for the raccoon friends? Hopefully this will help.

This will add the following mushrooms
[list]
[*]Common Mushrooms
[*]Purple Mushrooms
[*]Chanterelles
[*]Morels
[/list]
To these maps:
[list]
[*]Forest
[*]Secret Woods
[*]Town
[*]Mountains
[*]Backwoods
[/list]
If you run into compat issues, please let me know. Mod was tested with SVE installed. 

This was specifically created so my wife could finish a specific raccoon bundle, she's been trying for an entire in-game year. I hope you find it useful as well.
